title: UTM Transition-Rule Compiler
rule_template: Rule-110-style binary local update on the gap track, plus deterministic hole-track advance h -> h+1 mod 6
connection_to_BT1858: BT1858 supplies the 12-symbol tape alphabet. BT1861 supplies a local transition rule on that alphabet.
boundary: Transition-rule compiler only. It is Rule-110-style and executable as a symbolic local rule, but no full physical universal-machine simulation or halting/gadget proof is claimed.
